title: chant search output
description: What `chant search --json` and `chant workspace search --json` print, version 1 of the read contract (#4374, ws-017). Plain `chant search` answers over one project. `chant workspace search` runs that same search in every chant member, under the member's own chant (ws-021), and composes the answers with the `<member>/<id>` ids `chant workspace graph` gives the same nodes; each member is searched alone, so no path crosses from one member into another, except for a query that names a capability (`cap:`, `->[cap=...]`, #4375): its rules run once, under the workspace's chant, over the graph `chant workspace graph` composes, and a path may cross wherever that graph has an edge. A result lists `matches`; with `--count-by` it lists `groups` and `total` instead; a refusal lists `error` and exits 1. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The error and reason codes are closed lists from the one list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 is written by chant 0.81.0 and newer; this document is written by chant 0.124.46 and newer, and an older `search --json` has no `contract` field.

result.description: The rows that matched. Exit 0, or 1 when a live read failed, `--fail-on-drift` found drift, or in the workspace form a member failed.

chant.description: The version of the chant that wrote the document.

at.description: The full commit id of the source searched (`workspace search --at <rev>`), or null for the working tree. Plain `chant search` reads the working tree, so it is always null there. This is the git-revision axis; the snapshot axis is `source.snapshot`.

members.description: `chant workspace search` only: every member the search covers, in declaration order, with its own answer or the reason it has none.

provenance.description: Plain `chant search`: the provenance line the text prints after the rows, without its leading dash. In the workspace form each member carries its own.

plannedCreates.description: Plain `chant search`, `--live` or `--snapshot` only: present when every match is a planned create (an absent entity carrying plan attributes, #4372), with how many. The provenance line says "N planned creates, none bound yet" instead of "returned no bound resources". Absent for a real empty read, a failed read, or any answer with a match that is not a planned create.

liveFailures.description: Plain `chant search`: the lexicons whose live read failed, with why. Exit 1. In the workspace form each member carries its own.

matches.description: The matched nodes. In the workspace form, sorted by id.

capabilities.description: Present when the query names a capability (#4375): each one, the observation its facts were derived from, and what it does not evaluate.

counts.description: `--count-by` (#4360): the matched set grouped, in place of the rows. In the workspace form, `groups` adds the members' groups up by name, except that a `module` group is prefixed with its member (`<member>/<module>`), since a module in two members is two modules.

chant.description: The version of the chant that wrote the document.

at.description: The full commit id of the source searched (`workspace search --at <rev>`), or null for the working tree. Plain `chant search` reads the working tree, so it is always null there. This is the git-revision axis; the snapshot axis is `source.snapshot`.

members.description: `chant workspace search` only: every member the search covers, in declaration order, with its own answer or the reason it has none.

provenance.description: Plain `chant search`: the provenance line the text prints after the rows, without its leading dash. In the workspace form each member carries its own.

liveFailures.description: Plain `chant search`: the lexicons whose live read failed, with why. Exit 1. In the workspace form each member carries its own.

total.description: The number of matches, the sum of the groups' counts.

failure.description: The search was refused before any answer: the query or flags, the project's environment, snapshot or build, or in the workspace form the declaration or `--at`. Exit 1.

chant.description: The version of the chant that wrote the document.

hint.description: What to do instead, as stderr prints it after the error. `revision-unknown` from `workspace search --at` names `--snapshot` here.

workspace.description: The workspace searched, or for plain `chant search` the one the project belongs to, when it belongs to one (ws-016).

root.description: The workspace root relative to the git root, "." for the git root itself.

source.description: Which observation answered. `declared` is the source graph; `live` reads the account now; `snapshot` replays a recorded lifecycle snapshot. In the workspace form the top-level source names the axis asked for, and each member's source names the snapshot commit it replayed.

snapshot.description: The snapshot ref asked for with `--snapshot` (or plain search's `--at`), such as `latest`.

depth.description: `live` only, present when the plan read (CHANT_TERRAFORM_OBSERVE=plan) answered at least one bound match (#4384): `plan` or `live+plan` when every read match came that way, `mixed` when the matches were read at different depths (see `reads`). Absent for a plain live or state answer.

reads.description: `live` only, with `depth` or `planFellBackTo`: the distinct reads that answered the bound matches, sorted. These are the lexicon's per-entity `sources` values (#2267).

planFellBackTo.description: `live` only: the plan read was asked for and failed, and this read answered instead. `declared` means no read answered and the rows are unobserved.

id.description: The graph's full id: stack-qualified (`stack::name`) where the graph qualifies it, and in the workspace form `<member>/<id>`, as `chant workspace graph` prints the same node.

member.description: Workspace form: the member the row came from.

displayId.description: The bare name the text row prints.

unobserved.description: Why a live or replayed read has no observation of the node, such as `read-failed`.

show.description: The `--show` attributes the node carries, under the names the graph spells them with.

paths.description: One per positive edge term and cap: term the node matched through. Empty when the query has none.

term.description: The edge term, or the cap: term, as the grammar spells it.

from.description: The edge's consumer end, a full id (`<member>/<id>` in the workspace form).

edge.description: On a capability's path (#4375): the name the capability rules give the edge, such as statement or resource. Its from or to may be a node inside a resource, `<id>#<attr>[n]...`.

hops.description: In walk order from the match. Each hop keeps the edge's own direction.

because.description: On a cap: term (#4375): each set the match relied on, with the path that proved it.

explain.description: `--explain`: the universe the query ran over and why near misses were left out.

fails.description: The first term the node fails.

drift.description: `--check-live` or `--check-snapshot`: the matched rows checked against the observation the answer did not use. `unavailable` alone when there was nothing to check against.

groups.description: Each group and its count, highest count first, then by name. A node with no value for the grouped dimension counts under `(none)`.

ids.description: The ids of the matches in the group, in match order (#4382); `count` is its length. In the workspace form they are `<member>/<id>`, and a merged group lists them only when every member that counted into it listed its own (an older member chant lists none). Written by chant 0.124.46 and newer.

dir.description: Relative to the workspace root, with / separators; "." is the root member.

status.description: `searched` when the member answered; `skipped` when the workspace commands don't run its kind; `failed` when it has no answer. A failed member is never reported as zero matches.

code.description: A member that ran and refused carries its own search refusal code. `member-chant-too-old` is a member whose chant prints no search document of the contract, or, for a query with a capability term, no capability view (#4378).

chant.description: The chant version the member's toolchain reported, or null when a chant older than member-run read it, or the member did not run.

stamp.description: The member's stamp by the rule of ws-059 (the reference's Member stamps): sha256 over its files and install state, or over the commit id with --at. null when none could be taken. Search is never served from the graph cache.

alone.description: On a searched member: its terms and paths saw only its own graph. Paths that cross members are not walked.

matches.description: The member's matched ids, `<member>/<id>`, each a row of the top-level `matches`.

plannedCreates.description: As in the result document: present when every counted match is a planned create.
